verdict.rationale: Langfuse's only documented recurring job is scheduled Blob Storage Export, a narrow built-in recurring export rather than general job or workflow scheduling. CI/CD experiments run through GitHub Actions, which is host-platform scheduling, and production LLM-as-a-judge evaluators run continuously on live traffic rather than on a user-defined schedule, so neither earns credit. Missing for 10: general user-defined recurring schedules for workflows, scheduled experiment or evaluation runs, schedule configuration details (cron/intervals), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
